notes.title: Special Sale and Free Copies
notes.content:
Hello everyone. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7872609/3f19621fead22c6a4730c2fa9d8f79351781917f.jpg[/img]

All AngelsBlue's titles, including Coffin of Ashes, Gun Wings, Notch - The Innocent LunA, and Starlight of Aeons, are on sale up to 60% off from the 21st of September to the 5th of October.

https://store.steampowered.com/search/?developer=Angels%20Blue%20Digital%20Entertainment

If you enjoy free things, we are also giving away 5 free copies of the Angels Blue Games Bundle. https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1390/Angels_Blue_Games/

To opt in to the giveaway, please do the following:

1. Follow @digitalezstudio on Twitter. https://twitter.com/digitalezstudio
2. Retweet this tweet: https://twitter.com/digitalezstudio/status/1043522642509099009

We'll randomly pick 5 lucky winners on the 4th of October, and the keys will be sent via private message on Twitter.

Thank you for your support, and good luck to you all!

notes.title: 《刻痕》1月10日更新說明
notes.content:
一個《刻痕》的新補丁目前已經被推送。此次更新解決了部分我們已發現的問題。如果您在遊戲過程中遇到錯誤，請在[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/325120/discussions/0/598198356171763092/]這個帖子[/url]回覆。

補丁說明：

1. 修正部分縮放特效的錯誤。

2. 更新了一個在某些情況下可能導致存檔數據錯誤的腳本。

3. 修正一個對話框不正常工作的錯誤。

4. 增加和修改了幾張遊戲中的背景圖。

5. 其它小的修復。

感謝您對《刻痕》的支持。

notes.title: Notch Update 10th Jan, 2016
notes.content:
A new patch for Notch - The Innocent LunA: Eclipsed SinnerS has been released. This patch fixes several bugs we found. If you encounter any bugs or mistakes, feel free to report it in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/325120/discussions/0/598198356171763092/]this thread[/url].

Update log:

1. Fixed a bug involving the zoom effect.

2. Updated the script to avoid savedata corruption under certain circumstances.

3. Fixed a bug about the message box not working correctly.

4. Added & modified several background CG.

5. Some other small fixes.

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Notch - The Innocent LunA: Eclipsed SinnerS Update #651302
notes.content:
A new patch (BuildID 651302) for Notch - The Innocent LunA: Eclipsed SinnerS has been released, please restart your Steam client and it will automatically update to the latest version.

*Fixed a crash related to some non-Unicode systems.

*Fixed some translation mistakes. 

======================================================

《刻痕》的一个新补丁（BuildID 651302）已经被推送，请重新启动Steam客户端，它将自动更新游戏至最新版本。

*解决在某些非unicode系统环境下可能出现的游戏崩溃问题。

*修复了部分文字翻译错误。
